text: XXI. 1. Tīhi bhikkhave ṭhānehi Uttarakurukā manussā deve ca Tāvatiṃse adhigaṇhanti Jambudīpake ca manusse. Katamehi tīhi? 2. Amamā apariggahā niyatāyukā visesabhuno Imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi ṭhānehi Uttarakurukā manussā deve ca Tāvatiṃse adhigaṇhanti Jambudīpake ca manusse. 3. Tīhi bhikkhave ṭhānehi devā Tāvatiṃsā Uttarakuruke ca manusse adhigaṇhanti Jambudīpake ca manusse. Katamehi tīhi? 4. Dibbena āyunā dibbena vaṇṇena dibbena sukhena. Imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi ṭhānehi devā Tāvatiṃsā Uttarakuruke ca manusse adhigaṇhanti Jambudīpake ca manusse. 5. Tīhi bhikkhave ṭhānehi Jambudīpake manussā Uttarakuruke ca manusse adhigaṇhanti deve ca Tāvatiṃse. Katamehi tīhi? Surā satimanto idhabrahmacariyavāso. Imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi ṭhānehi Jambudīpakā manussā Uttarakuruke ca manusse adhigaṇhanti deve ca Tāvatiṃse ti. [page 397] XXII. 1-4 Sattāvāsa-Vagga. 397
